'''2000 German National Championship Markus Wüst Break Stuff ver 1 1''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Markus Wüst]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 3rd at [[2000 German National Championship]]. The post says: 'I finshed 3rd on the german national with this deck'. His Dark list from the same event is DeckTech post 6235 (Der Abschaum der Gesellschaft), which names this deck as his Light deck there.<ref name="dt-6007">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6007 Break Stuff ver 1 1], DeckTech (Markus "Lone Gunner" Wuest, 26 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6007/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6007/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018180023/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6007/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Break Stuff ver 1 1'''
* '''Author:''' Markus "Lone Gunner" Wuest
* '''Published:''' April 26, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Main Mains and more mains

=== Strategy ===

Just a post to stay in active mode

Notes

No SAC protection, because its not common in my region Almost no numbers protection, because nobody plays dark side numbers

The plan

use your good activation to get the mains out and bsh the dark side the cycling destinies will provide good draws...

cheers

I finshed 3rd on the german national with this deck
